name: DeployStatus - Published, Still Updating
description: How a watch that runs out of budget now ends. pollDeploy used to return whichever in-flight stage it was sitting on — a non-terminal value nothing could move off — which is what left the panel unclosable. It resolves to 'unconfirmed' instead: the commit is stated as fact, the deploy is not claimed, and there are three ways out (Check again, View live site, Done). Captured because the wording carries it — this has to read as a slow deploy, not a failure.
